title: The Andersen-Hoffman Theorem for Equitable Rectangles
summary: More than forty years ago, Andersen and Hoffman independently proved that every symmetric Latin rectangle can be extended to a symmetric Latin square with prescribed diagonal entries. We generalize this theorem as follows. Let $k\leq n^2$, and let $M$ be an $n\times n$ array whose top-left $r\times r$ subarray is filled with symbols from $\{1,2,\ldots,k\}$.
